messages:
Nora: Quick sync  we keep losing confirmed design partners in the final week. Need a compact retention playbook for pilots.
Evan: Hypothesis: unclear commitment steps + last-minute calendar conflicts. Proposal: require booking + checklist inside 72h of acceptance.
Priya: Add a lightweight "commit pledge" step in acceptance flow: checkbox acknowledging expected time and incentive. It increases perceived commitment.
Samir: Ops constraints: if a slot shifts <7 days before start and it needs infra, we may not be able to provision. Add "infra-required" flag on intake form.
ops-bot: Reminder templates ready.
- 48h: "Please confirm and schedule your onboarding (link) to secure your spot."
- 12h: "Final notice: your pilot slot will be released in 12 hours if not confirmed."
Nora: No-show policy: if they miss onboarding booking and two human outreaches, release slot. If they decline, capture reason (timing/scope/budget/other) and offer waitlist.
Evan: Waitlist swap checklist: repo access, sample data, primary contact. Must be completed before marking replacement "confirmed."
Priya: Metrics: accept->booked (target 92%), booked->attended (95%), accept->completion (target 75%), time-to-fill on release (target <72h). Track decline reasons.
Samir: Implementation: add dashboard columns for "checklist status" and "infra-required". Alerts when a confirmed partner is within 5 days of start but missing booking or checklist.
Nora: Owner actions: Priya drafts acceptance + decline copy; Evan wires Calendly and reminders; Samir adds intake flags and alerts; I'll compile the one-pager and run the first compact cohort next week.
Priya: I'll post draft by EOD for 24h review. If approved, enable automation and test with a small pilot group. :rocket:
